sbar.situation: The bank system has recovered. The gateway now shows correct balances, and one recovery check at 11 s ran the main journey cleanly.
sbar.background: The deployment pipeline changed the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 s to 600 s. This happened about 16 s before the incident was assessed. After that, the app showed stale balances after payments posted: it showed 99999900 while the ledger held 99999800.
sbar.assessment: The root cause was this bad configuration on the gateway (confidence 0.9). The incident commander reverted balance_cache_ttl_s from 600.0 back to 0.5 itself, and the follow-up check was clean. The screening-standby restarts were routine maintenance and caused no symptom.
sbar.recommendation: Find out why the pipeline set balance_cache_ttl_s to 600, and block that change so it is not redeployed. Operations should review whether customers acted on stale balances shown while the 600 s cache was live.
